notes: The assigned mob-3010 postmaster intercepts the registered mail command; a level-1 player is shown C's exact minimum-level refusal before argument or mail-store access (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
After the live target is raised to level 5, mail with no argument reaches the C one_argument empty-addressee refusal before identity lookup (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
The same postmaster path with an addressee and zero gold reaches C's two-line 25-coin refusal before identity lookup or mail persistence (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).

With sufficient stamp money, an unregistered name reaches the C identity-miss branch and its named postmaster response; the saved-recipient success path is tracked separately below (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5g/R5h).
An empty seeded mailbox reaches the direct receive refusal before creating a note (src/mail.c:567-570; src/spec_assign.c:214; R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5g/R5h).
A saved Testor recipient starts the real string writer; a peer in the postmaster room receives the start act (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5g/R5h).
The shipped Testor identity resolves, the sender pays one stamp, and the postmaster emits C's writer instructions (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5g/R5h).
